+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-settable paths/URLs.
+
+Users can store arbitrary strings in fields such as ``StoryCut.image_path``.
+The backend must never issue a request to such an address (SSRF), so images
+are only ever read from our own storage (through the storage client, not
+HTTP) or decoded from ``data:`` URLs.
+"""
+import base64
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def _storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Maps a reference to an object key in our storage, or None if it points elsewhere."""
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    lowered = ref.lower()
+    if lowered.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        if not host or not ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+            return None
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif "://" in ref or lowered.startswith(("//", "file:")):
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or "?" in key or "#" in key or "\\" in key or ".." in key.split("/"):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns image bytes for a data: URL, a storage URL or a storage path; None otherwise."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        try:
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+    key = _storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io

+
+import pytest

+PNG = base64.b64decode(
+    "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
+)
+EVIL = [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/projects",
+    "https://internal.example/x.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000.evil.example/x.png",
+    "gopher://10.0.0.1/x",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    def boom(*a, **k):
+        raise AssertionError("backend made an outbound request")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", boom)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", boom)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def stored():
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, "cuts", "t")
+    return key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", EVIL)
+def test_loader_refuses_foreign_addresses(url):
+    from app.services.image_loader import load_image_bytes
+
+    assert load_image_bytes(url) is None
+
+
+def test_loader_reads_storage_and_data_urls(stored):
+    from app.services.image_loader import load_image_bytes
+
+    key, url = stored
+    assert load_image_bytes(key) == PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes(url) == PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes("data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()) == PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes(url.replace(key, "cuts/../x")) is None

+
+    assert BaseAIService._download_image(object.__new__(BaseAIService), url) is None

+

+    _, url = stored

+def _episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": p["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    eid = e.json()["id"]
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": 1})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{c.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})

+
